sourceFile: 27. BRS-201506 Report checking and test SUB2  date 12.3.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft identifies a relevant JIG comparison but misgroups dates, omits an apparent jig comparison, and includes unsupported measurement outcomes.
issues: Change domain should be jig/equipment/process, not material.
Apr 11 New JIG is paired with Apr 9 Normal line instead of same-date Normal line.
Early Normal jig vs Test jig class result appears omitted or mixed into the wrong factor.
Header-derived measurement outcomes are not valid final evidence.
Some key cited rows lack full context text, especially row 29.
requiredUserQuestions: Should rows 15-20 be a separate Normal jig vs Test jig comparison or part of the same JIG validation?
correctionPlan: Reclassify changed factor as JIG/equipment/process condition.
Group New JIG vs Normal line by inherited date: Apr 9 rows 30/32 and Apr 11 rows 34/36.
Add or explicitly exclude the Normal jig vs Test jig class 1-3 comparison with supporting rows.
Remove header-only measurement statistics unless real data rows support them.
Cite complete header and data rows for each outcome, including row 29 details if used.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row IDs exist, but citations are insufficient because key outcomes are mispaired or header-only.
